sources.excerpt: There has been a major global Microsoft outage since 12 November 2026, with users in more than 70 countries reporting issues with numerous services including Microsoft 365, Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.
Microsoft said that the outage was not caused by a cyber attack or AI agents, and blamed the outage on settings applied to servers after an update.
The outage continued into Friday 13 November, affecting businesses, airlines and government agencies worldwide.
The 27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards ceremony was held on November 12, 2026, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas.
Puerto Rican actress Roselyn Sánchez served as host for the tenth time.
Puerto Rican rapper and singer Daddy Yankee was announced as this year's Latin Recording Academy Person of the Year.
U.S. Rep-elect Bobby Pulido of Texas's 15th congressional district wins a Latin Grammy Award for Best Tejano Album.
Winning the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1967, his work helped bring attention to the importance of indigenous cultures, especially those of his native Guatemala.
Asturias spent his final years in Madrid, where he died in 1974. He is buried in the 10th division of the Père Lachaise Cemetery in Paris.
Asturias' ashes arrived in Guatemala City on 12 November 2026 with a ceremony attended by President Arévalo. His remains will be interred at the Centro Cultural Miguel Ángel Asturias on 15 November.
In experiments involving two carrion crows, the birds needed an average of just 235 milliseconds to determine which way a pattern of moving dots was traveling and respond with their choice.
Crows can make visual decisions twice as quickly as humans and monkeys, according to new research from the University of Tübingen.
Just 70 milliseconds after the moving dots appeared, neurons associated with the different choices were already showing distinct patterns of activity.
